ai.seo_question: What is the significance of describing the Quran as a revelation from Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this phrase underscores the divine provenance of the Quran, linking its descent to the merciful attributes of Allah that characterize the relationship between the Creator and the faithful. It serves as a preamble to the revelation's purpose, emphasizing that the guidance contained within is an act of divine grace (rahmah) intended for all of humanity. This attribution reinforces the belief that the Quran is not merely a human composition but a direct transmission from the All-Merciful.
